answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with slashable identity bonds. Each agent locks collateral to mint one voting identity, and any proven clone slashes every linked bond. Honest nodes broadcast a heartbeat pulse so twins are exposed, while votes count stake rather than headcount. A fraudster hiding a knoll of fake accounts still pays real collateral for each one and risks losing all of it, so a takeover costs more than the prize. Even with a willow budget the ledger stays safe.
